Type: faux fur throw cushion
Use: accent seating comfort, on a sofa or a bed; living room, bedroom
Style: glam, contemporary, Scandinavian
Materials: plush faux fur pile
Colors: ivory, warm light beige tips
Shape: square, solid shaggy plush texture with soft tonal variation, plump, knife edges, large
Feel: soft, cozy, luxurious
Goes with: velvet, grey or white bedding, brass or mirrored accents; glam, Scandinavian or modern rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Modern Faux Fur Decorative Throw Pillow, Soft and Luxurious, 20" x 20", Ivory
product.description: Add a touch of luxury to your room with this plush pillow. Amazingly soft faux fur exudes glamour along with warmth and coziness. For a different look, flip it over to the solid ivory side. Neutral ivory will enhance any style bedroom. Pillow cover features hidden bottom zipper 20"L x 20"W, Pillow cover dimensions are measured from seam to seam when cover is laid flat. Spot clean with damp white cloth and allow to air dry
